comments.author: Theo
comments.body:
This aide is useful for god cannon users. Because modded chainshots do the most damage at long range with Enhanced chainshot (considering it as a bug of damage modelling among different shot types).

However, using this aide would also mean you are super squishy to master cannons. 600+ damage per broadside is not funny at all.
